test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The curved surface area of a right circular cone is 5400π cm², and the diameter of its base is 144 cm. Find the height (in cm) of the cone.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius (r) = 144 ÷ 2 = 72 cm

CSA = πrl ⇒ 5400π = π × 72 × l

l = 5400 ÷ 72 = 75 cm

Using Pythagorean triplet (7, 24, 25) × 3 → (21, 72, 75)

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 5400π cm²

**Diameter** = 144 cm ⇒ **Radius (r)** = 72 cm

**Formula Used:**

CSA of Cone = πrl

Slant height (l) = √(h² + r²)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cf7e7f1262c085f0ba9083b80c202e580ba35a8e08b797a76a0c5a986e52c3b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ π × 72 × l = 5400π

⇒ l = 5400 ÷ 72

⇒ l = 75 cm

⇒ h² = l² − r²

⇒ h² = 75² − 72²

⇒ h² = (75 − 72)(75 + 72)

⇒ h² = 3 × 147

⇒ h² = 441

⇒ h = √441 = 21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cone

TSA = πr(l + r), which includes the curved area and the circular base area.

Volume of Cone

Volume = (1/3)πr²h, which is exactly one-third the volume of a cylinder with the same radius and height.

Slant Height Relation

In a right circular cone, l² = h² + r² based on the **Pythagoras Theorem**.</p
